problem.text: What is the sum of all positive integers $n$ such that $\text{lcm}(2n, n^2) = 14n - 24$?

steps.title: Where to start: pull out the common factor $n$
steps.body: Both $2n$ and $n^2$ are $n$ times something: $2n = n\cdot 2$ and $n^2 = n\cdot n$. Multiplying two numbers by the same $n$ multiplies their LCM by $n$, so $\text{lcm}(2n, n^2) = n\cdot\text{lcm}(2, n)$. Now $\text{lcm}(2, n)$ depends only on whether $n$ is odd or even, so we split into those two cases.

your_turn.prompt: What is $\text{lcm}(2, n)$ when $n$ is odd? When $n$ is even?
your_turn.answer: If $n$ is odd, $2$ and $n$ share no factor, so it is $2n$. If $n$ is even, $2$ already divides $n$, so it is $n$.

steps.title: Case 1: $n$ is odd
steps.body: Here the LCM is $n\cdot 2n = 2n^2$, so we need $2n^2 = 14n - 24$. Divide by $2$ and move everything to one side to get a quadratic. Careful: any root you find must also be odd, because that is the case we assumed.

your_turn.prompt: Solve $n^2 - 7n + 12 = 0$. Which root is allowed in this case?
your_turn.answer: $(n-3)(n-4) = 0$, so $n = 3$ or $n = 4$. Only $n = 3$ is odd, so $4$ is thrown out here.

steps.title: Case 2: $n$ is even
steps.body: Now the LCM is $n\cdot n = n^2$, so we need $n^2 = 14n - 24$, which is $n^2 - 14n + 24 = 0$. Again, keep only the roots that are even. (Note that $n = 4$ from Case 1 is not lost by accident: it is even, so it belongs to this case, and it must satisfy this equation to count.)

your_turn.prompt: Factor $n^2 - 14n + 24$ and check the parity of each root.
your_turn.answer: $(n-2)(n-12)$, since $2\cdot 12 = 24$ and $2 + 12 = 14$. Both $2$ and $12$ are even, so both are allowed. And $4$ is not a root, since $16 - 56 + 24 = -16$.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body: Check in the original equation: $\text{lcm}(6, 9) = 18 = 14\cdot 3 - 24$, $\text{lcm}(4, 4) = 4 = 14\cdot 2 - 24$, and $\text{lcm}(24, 144) = 144 = 14\cdot 12 - 24$. Every positive integer is odd or even, so these are all the solutions: $n = 2$, $3$, $12$. Their sum is $2 + 3 + 12 = 17$. The answer is **$17$**.
